name: Shredclaw

related.relation: the old jaw whose ground he waits to take

facts.text: Shredclaw is a level-66 named with 30,000 health in Faraheim; three blood renders come with him.
Allakhazam lists Shredclaw as an animal of level 66 in Faraheim that gives master-level experience.

When he is fought, his three blood renders (ShredclawBaf, within 2,500) join him. On 35% of his hits he poisons his target (100 body over 30 s, if it has no such effect) and on 35% makes it bleed (45 over 30 s, if not already bleeding; it does not stack). 30,000 health, CC-immune, reach 350; resets at full health.

story:
Shredclaw is the young one. He came out of the old jaw's own pack, the dwarves say, a render who would not wait his turn, and was driven north across the empty strip with three others who would not wait either. They took the north of the east as their ground and have held it since, and he has grown into it, and the claw-marks he leaves on the trunks there are deeper every year.

Where Goretooth bites, Shredclaw tears. His claws open wounds that will not close and leave a poison in them besides, and he does not stop to let the prey be still; he goes on tearing, and the three come in from the sides. A hunter who goes into his ground comes out bleeding or does not come out. The skogsra of Dalgo's wood, who are his nearest neighbours, move their paths away from his trunks.

He has never crossed the strip. The dwarves have watched him from griffon-back walk to its edge, and stand, and look south toward the old jaw's ground for a long time, and go back. They think he is waiting for Goretooth to weaken. They also think he does not know how to wait, which is the only reason they sleep at all: a render who cannot wait will go through the strip one day before the old jaw is ready to lose, and the old jaw will kill him, and the east will be quiet again for a generation. The dwarves would like that very much. They are not sure enough of it to bet a griffon.

Like the old jaw, he has never been held by snare or charm. The dwarves say renders are made that way: slippery as a fish and twice as cold.
legend: Shredclaw is the younger blood render in the north-east of Faraheim, level 66, 30,000 health, with three renders that come when you touch him. Poison (100 body over 30 seconds) and a bleed (45 over 30 seconds) on whoever he's hitting, each on a 35% chance per hit; neither stacks, so it's steady pressure rather than a spike. Bring cure poison and keep steady heals on the tank. A bit easier than Goretooth; still a full-group pull. CC-immune, reach 350, resets full if you leave. He's well away from Goretooth, so the packs won't mix unless you drag the fight.

bookPage: From A Map That Lies, by Gunnvor of Jordheim: the dwarves showed me the young render standing at the northern edge of the empty strip. He stood there all the while we circled, a long time, looking south, his three behind him, and his tail moving like a cat's. Then he turned and went back into his own wood and raked a trunk as he passed it, so hard I heard it from the air. The dwarf said: one day he will not turn back. I asked what would happen then. She said the empty strip would be full for an afternoon.
